body:
Assigned to taliesin-ai. Initial documentation coverage audit against master `af7026b14`:

- 188 English Markdown/MDX pages.
- Indonesian: 167 matching translated pages; 21 missing.
- German, French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese: 20 matching pages each; 168 missing per language.
- `docs/astro.config.mjs` currently enables only the English root locale.

These are file-coverage counts, not translation-quality or freshness certification. Before this can be closed, we need the GA language scope, enabled locale routing, missing translations, a freshness/API accuracy pass and a passing documentation build/link check. The required GA languages have been requested from the maintainer in the working task. Keeping the issue in progress; its requested one-line description is preserved.
